Name: C.R.O.P.S. ATM Mod
Author: BeetleJuice20
Description:
[center][size=6][color=#FFD700]💳 C.R.O.P.S. ATM Mod – Currency Reserve & Official Pelican Savings[/color][/size]
[size=4][color=#E0C97F]Modern Banking in [color=#FF6666]Stardew Valley[/color][/color][/size][/center]

[color=#E0C97F]Money makes the farm go ‘round — but who says managing it has to be boring? With a shiny new card in your pocket and a stylish ATM waiting in town, you’ll feel like Pelican Town’s most sophisticated farmer. Step aside.

Whether you’re saving up for that dream barn, splurging on a full stock of starfruit seeds, or just showing off your fancy plastic, this is more than just another trip to the store — it’s a whole new way to live the [color=#FF6666]Stardew[/color] life.[/color]

[color=#C0C0C0]I made this inspired by Animal Crossing ABD (Automatic Bell Deposit) and thought it would be fun to make an ATM for [color=#FF6666]Stardew Valley[/color]. I got assistance from ChatGPT for help bringing this mod to life. I’m very happy with how it turned out and hope you enjoy it![/color]

[color=#AAAAAA]This is 99% bug free; the 1% is you finding the bugs I didn’t come across. If you find any bugs, please post them and I’ll fix them when I can.[/color]

[b]NOTE:[/b]
1. When you buy items in the shop using the card, the item won’t appear on the mouse but will be in your inventory.
2. In the shop, when the item is grayed out but if you have enough gold to buy it with the card, you can still buy it.

[b][b]Warning[/b]:[/b] If you play in multiplayer, be careful dropping your card around other players. If another player picks it up, the gold you had on the card will be gone.


[size=4][b][color=#FFD700]🌟 Core Features[/color][/b][/size]

[b]🏦 ATM Banking[/b]
[list]
[*]Store up to 50,000,000g in your personal ATM account.
[*]Deposit or withdraw any amount instantly from the ATM.
[*]Shared ATM for all players in multiplayer.
[/list]

🏦 [b]ATM Tier Levels[/b][list]
[*]There 14 tiers ranging from Turnip Saver to The Golden Clock.

[*]Each tier increase the max amount of gold on the card, how much loan you can pull out daily, and the credit debt limit. 
[*]Once you reach the top tier you have the option to upgrade the ATM to hold 1 billion gold. 
[/list]

[b]💳 CROPS ATM Card[/b]
[list]
[*]Carry up to 200,000g on your card for purchases.
[*]Use Card Mode to pay directly from your card in any shop, or switch to Wallet Mode with the press of a key (default: C).
[*]The card is available to buy in Pierre's Shop.
[*]You only need one. Duplicates don’t provide extra benefits.
[/list]

[b][b]💳 [/b]C.R.O.P.S. ATM Card now supports four distinct modes — all in a single card[/b]

[list]
[*]Switch modes in the CROPS Card settings. (default: [b]F6[/b]).  
[*][b]Debit Mode[/b] – Use your stored card balance for purchases, just like a standard bank card.  
[*][b]Credit Mode[/b] – Buy now, pay later. Borrow directly at checkout with daily interest and flexible repayment modes.  
[*][b]Loan Mode[/b] – Take out structured loans with caps, daily limits, and configurable repayment plans.  
[*][b]Linked ATM Mode[/b] – Your card mirrors your ATM account for seamless spending.  
[/list]

[b]🛒 Shop Integration[/b]
[list]
[*]Works with all in-game shops.
[*]Card purchases automatically draw from your card balance, with any remaining cost covered by your wallet.
[*]Displays your card balance in the shop UI with a custom card icon.
[/list]

[b]📜 Transaction History[/b]
[list]
[*]7-day rolling log of card transactions.
[*]Grouped by in-game date, with each purchase showing the item name, quantity, and icon.
[*]Scrollable history menu that resizes for your screen.
[/list]

[b]📈 Daily Interest[/b]
[list]
[*]Earn 0.5% interest on your ATM balance at the start of each day.
[*]Interest is added directly to your ATM.
[/list]

[b]🔒 Secure Card Handling[/b]
[list]
[*]Trashing or shipping your card triggers a confirmation dialogue.
[*]Card balance is automatically refunded to your ATM account if trashed or shipped.
[/list]


[size=4][b][color=#FFD700]🚀 How to Get Started[/color][/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Get Your Card[/b] – Purchase it at the shop.
[*][b]Find an ATM[/b] – Located next to Harvey's Clinic.
[*][b]Manage Your Money[/b] – Use the ATM to transfer funds between your wallet, card, and ATM account.
[*][b]Shop Smart[/b] – Toggle between Card Mode and Wallet Mode in shops to control your spending source.
[/list]


[size=4][b][color=#FFD700]⚙ Config Options[/color][/b][/size]
[list]
[*]    Shop Toggle Key "C" – Change the default card/wallet switch key using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url].
[/list]

[size=4][b][color=#FFD700]🤝 Multiplayer Support[/color][/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Each card is player-bound for security.
[*]Perfect for co-op farms where you want personal control over your gold.
[/list]
[b]My Mods[/b]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/36835]SV Player Stats[/url]
[/list]


[center][size=4][color=#E0C97F]💬 “Banking has never been this fun in Stardew Valley. Your farm is thriving — now let your finances do the same!”[/color][/size][/center]
